title: Modernize your UIKit app
description: Discover the latest updates to UIKit. Learn how to update your iPhone app layouts to work great when resized with iPhone Mirroring and on iPad. Explore new APIs for tab and navigation bars, find out how to prepare your app for new Apple Intelligence capabilities, and get introduced to a skill for your coding agent of choice that helps modernize your codebase.

resources.title: TN3208: Preparing your app’s launch screen to meet App Store requirements
resources.description: Understand the launch screen requirement for App Store submission starting in iOS 27 and iPadOS 27.

resources.title: TN3210: Optimizing your app for iPhone Mirroring
resources.description: Test your app and improve compatibility with iPhone Mirroring.

resources.title: Make your UIKit app more flexible
resources.description: Find out how your UIKit app can become more flexible on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro by using scenes and container view controllers. Learn to unlock your app's full potential by transitioning from an app-centric to a scene-based lifecycle, including enhanced window resizing and improved multitasking. Explore enhancements to UISplitViewController, such as interactive column resizing and first-class support for inspector columns. And make your views and controls more adaptive by adopting new layout APIs.

resources.title: Adapting your app when traits change
resources.description: Find out when system changes happen that affect your app, then update your app efficiently.

resources.title: Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle
resources.description: Adopt the scene-based life cycle to replace the app delegate life cycle in UIKit.

resources.title: Automatic trait tracking
resources.description: Reduce the need to manually register for trait changes when you use traits within a method or closure that supports automatic trait tracking.
